description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruvita D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 620274
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and identities, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and registration matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
